prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / focused portrait revision.
Input 1 is the first-pass portrait EDIT TARGET. Input 2 is original selected identity reference. Inputs 3–5 are style-only anchors. Keep the same person, age, sex, face proportions, angle and clothing colors. A single tight 74 x 100 logical-pixel medieval RPG dialogue HEAD. All hair, ears and collar fully contained with at least 2 logical pixels transparent side margin and 3 above. Full raw canvas will be fitted aspect-preservingly inside 72x98 on 74x100; do not clip raw content.
Hard broad low-resolution pixel clusters, 4–6 skin planes, maximum 32 muted colors, large clear nose/cheek/jaw anatomy and deliberate stepped edges. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background. No antialiasing, gradients, dithering, soft painting, hatching, microtexture or scattered accent pixels. No props, hands, shoulders, text, frame or extra people. An actual redraw, not merely crop/resize. Final technical NN and palette export is a disclosed non-native derivative.
SINO: clean-shaven man in his THIRTIES, slender long adult face, chestnut short side-part hair, long straight nose, gray robe/off-white lining/muted rust-red plain stole. Preserve face identity and small CLOSED asymmetrical polite half-smile. No younger or muscular face.
Essential expression change: relax central forehead completely. REMOVE both upright creases between brows. Draw INNER eyebrow ends LOWER than now, on a nearly HORIZONTAL baseline. Only one OUTER brow tip lifts very slightly. Calm attentive brows without central worry peak. A composed ceremony assistant assessing a visitor with practiced courtesy. No worried V, grief, pleading, smugness or holy serenity.
Reduce eye-white height and brightness to narrow dim gray-brown slivers. Small dark pupils, no white rectangle or sparkle.
SHORTEN exposed neck by HALF so jaw almost meets robe collar. Only bottom 5–7% has narrow charcoal/off-white/rust collar strip, no shoulder slopes. Keep face large, hair and ears contained.
Merge fine parallel hair ribbons and bands into only FOUR broad uneven chestnut masses with few wide dark stepped separations. Keep short side part, slightly less upper hair bulk. No little linework or segmented highlights. No religious symbols, props or story outcome.
